Method of Attack: Password-stealing Trojan that downloads and installs malware via obfuscated PowerShell scripts, detects if running in Any.Run sandbox and exits to avoid analysis, steals saved login credentials from browsers, FTP programs, and other software
Impacted Systems: Other software storing saved login credentials
Attack Vector: Malicious PowerShell scripts executed on victim's computer
Indicators of Compromise: Message 'Any.run Detected!' displayed when running in Any.Run sandbox
